missing: tap `before`/`after` scripts make every file of the session uncacheable; a test that reads tap's per-process variables (`TAP_CHILD_ID`, `TAP_JOB_ID`) is not cached; coverage is switched off under `--det-cache` (`--disable-coverage` is added).
evidence: docs/runners/tap.md "Refused or never cached" (before/after scripts: "every file of the session is uncacheable"; env-unobserved); node/src/runners/tap.js:91 `...(ctx.pc && !user.includes('--disable-coverage') ? ['--disable-coverage'] : [])`.

missing: AVA 5 and older are not supported (the shell requires AVA's ES-module internals through `require(esm)`): projects on AVA 3-5 cannot use detjs.
evidence: docs/runners/ava.md "Supported: AVA 6+ ... AVA 5 and older are not supported"; node/src/runners/ava.js:2 "(AVA 6+; built against AVA 8)". Not run with AVA 5.

missing: AVA files that use a shared worker (`ava/plugin`) are never cached, and with tsx (`nodeArguments: ['--import=tsx']`) the first run of each module is never cached (esbuild's worker thread counts as a worker of the test); the same first-run rule is documented for tap + tsx.
evidence: docs/runners/ava.md "Refused or never cached" (shared worker; "tsx ...: first transform of a module starts esbuild's worker thread: never cached that run"); docs/runners/tap.md "TypeScript / tsx: ... never cached (worker thread)". Not run.

missing: Only jasmine 5-7 is supported; with another jasmine-core build the `orderChildren` hook is not found and `--det-seed` silently keeps declaration order (a note in the trace, no error). `fdescribe`/`fit` files are never recorded as a pass.
evidence: docs/runners/jasmine.md "Supported: jasmine 5-7"; node/src/runners/jasmine.js:233-234 note "jasmine: orderChildren hook not found in jasmine-core: specs keep declaration order with --det-seed". Not run with jasmine 3/4.

missing: uvu test files run directly (`node test/x.js`, the usual way for uvu, tape and zora suites) are not covered: only the `uvu` CLI through `detjs uvu` is. If the uvu build's runner source is not recognised, every file of the run is failed closed.
evidence: docs/runners/uvu.md "uvu test files run directly with node test/x.js (no CLI) are not covered: use detjs uvu"; node/src/runners/uvu.js:219 "uvu runner source not recognised (...): tests are not bracketed".

missing: On Node 18 and 20 (and 22 before 22.15, no `module.registerHooks`) `detjs node-test --det-seed` does not shuffle the tests inside a file and does not force serial `concurrency`: only the file order follows the seed; a stderr line says so.
evidence: node/src/nodetest/preload.js:155 "detjs: module.registerHooks unavailable (Node < 22.15): test order is not shuffled"; docs/runners/node-test.md row "Node < 22.15 ... no node:test facade (no shuffle of tests, no serial concurrency)". Not run.

missing: `--watch` is refused under `--det`, `--test-global-setup` (Node 24) makes the whole run uncacheable, and tests that never begin (declared skipped, filtered) are missing from the trace and the receipts.
evidence: node/src/nodetest/cli.js:148 `throw new Error('detjs node-test: --watch is not supported under --det')`; cli.js `if (has(flags, '--test-global-setup')) pc.noteProject('', 'a --test-global-setup module runs in the runner process, outside the capture')`; docs/runners/node-test.md "Tests that never begin ... are not in the trace or the receipts".

missing: The `vmThreads` and `vmForks` pools are not controlled: tests run in another realm than the worker global, so the realm controls (Date, Math.random, timers) do not reach them, and such projects are never cached. detjs still prints "Level 0 active".
evidence: docs/NODE.md J2 "Vitest vmThreads/vmForks pools and browser mode run tests in another realm than the worker global: the realm controls do not reach them"; node/src/vitest/cli.js configParts `reason = 'pool ${c.pool} (tests run in another realm)'`. Not run.

missing: `isolate: false` (the setting Vitest itself recommends for speed) is never cached, and its module-level seeds are approximate (J10).
evidence: node/src/vitest/cli.js configParts `else if (c.isolate === false) reason = 'isolate=false (module state shared between files)'`; docs/NODE.md J10; docs/NODE-CACHE.md "Where state is shared between files (Vitest isolate: false, vmThreads/vmForks, browser mode, a custom Jest runner), the project is not cached". Not run.

missing: A project's own custom Vitest `runner` (config `test.runner`) is overwritten by the detjs runner on the CLI options and on every resolved project; the detjs runner extends Vitest's default runner, not the user's.
evidence: node/src/vitest/cli.js `Object.assign(options, {..., runner: runnerShim, ...})` and per project `c.runner = options.runner;`; node/src/vitest/shell.js loadBaseRunner() loads `VitestTestRunner`/`TestRunner` of vitest only. Not run.

missing: Watch mode is silently turned into a single run under `--det`: `detjs vitest --det` / `detjs vitest watch --det` drop the sub-command and set `watch: false`; no message, no deterministic watch.
evidence: node/src/vitest/cli.js `const args = rest[0] === 'run' || rest[0] === 'watch' || rest[0] === 'dev' ? rest.slice(1) : rest; parseCLI(['vitest', 'run', ...args])` and `Object.assign(options, { run: true, watch: false, ...})`. Not run.

missing: Running detjs needs a writable `<cwd>/node_modules/` (the runner shim `node_modules/.detjs/runner-<pid>.mjs` is written there) and resolves vitest from the working directory only: `--root DIR`/`--config DIR/...` pointing at another directory, a read-only node_modules, or a layout without node_modules (Yarn PnP) are not handled.
evidence: node/src/vitest/cli.js `const root = process.cwd(); ... findVitest(root)` (createRequire from cwd) and `const shimDir = path.join(root, 'node_modules', '.detjs'); fs.mkdirSync(shimDir, {recursive: true})`; same shim in node/src/jest/cli.js. Not run with PnP or --root.

missing: Jest `setupFiles` run before the detjs test runner: code there sees the real clock, real Math.random and real timers, and its events are not recorded (only `setupFilesAfterEnv` is controlled). Many projects seed polyfills, fake servers or env in setupFiles.
evidence: docs/NODE.md J3 "Jest setupFiles run before the detjs test runner (Jest calls them first): code there sees the real globals and its events are not recorded"; node/src/jest/runner.js installs the realm controls inside the testRunner function. Not run (project fj prepared, not executed).

missing: With the `jest-jasmine2` test runner there are no per-test brackets (controls only): no per-test fingerprints, seeds or shuffle of tests.
evidence: docs/NODE.md J3 "Jasmine (jest-jasmine2) runners get the controls but no per-test brackets"; node/src/jest/runner.js brackets through jest-circus events only (`environment.handleTestEvent`). Not run.

missing: Legacy fake timers (`jest.useFakeTimers({legacyFakeTimers: true})` / `timers: 'legacy'`) keep Jest's original real timers: after `useRealTimers()` the test is on real time, not on the virtual clock.
evidence: docs/NODE.md J3 "Legacy fake timers (legacyFakeTimers) keep Jest's original real timers"; node/src/jest/runner.js re-creates only `environment.fakeTimersModern`. Not run.

missing: A custom Jest `runner` (jest-light-runner, used by babel and prettier; also jest-runner-eslint, jest-runner-tsd style projects) is outside detjs: Level 0 does not apply (0 traced tests), only a warning; `DETJS_JEST_RUNNER=replace` makes those suites fail.
evidence: node/src/jest/cli.js: "detjs: WARNING custom Jest runner ...: Level 0 controls do not reach its tests (DETJS_JEST_RUNNER=replace uses jest-runner)"; docs/NODE.md J16 (babel 238/238, prettier 1429/1429 suites fail with replace).

missing: With Jest the reuse decision happens before `globalSetup`: a globalSetup that runs processes changes the start-up digest after the decision, and such suites rerun every file (no reuse at all).
evidence: docs/NODE-CACHE.md "Jest: in detjs' sequencer, which Jest calls before globalSetup (a globalSetup that runs processes changes the start-up digest after the decision: such suites rerun every file)". Not run.

missing: `--det-record` (network record/replay) is refused for Bun and Deno: Bun's and Deno's native connections are not recorded, so a test that needs an external host cannot be made replayable there.
evidence: node/src/runners/bun.js: "detjs bun-test: --det-record is not supported (Bun's native connections are not recorded)" return 2; docs/runners/deno.md "Refused with --det: --watch, --parallel, --shuffle, --seed, --det-record".

missing: Per-test outcome in the Bun and Deno traces can be wrong: a failure only the runtime sees (`expect.assertions`, a failing afterEach, Deno sanitizers) fails the file through the exit status, but the trace records that test as `passed`.
evidence: docs/runners/bun.md "the trace can say passed for that test"; docs/runners/deno.md "Per-test outcome as with Bun: a failure only Deno sees (sanitizers) fails the file through the exit status". Not run.

missing: `deno test --shard` is not handled by `detjs deno-test`: the flag is in none of its option tables and discovery is detjs' own directory walk, which applies no shard, so CI sharding with Deno under `--det` is undefined (the space form `--shard 2/3` would be read as a file argument).
evidence: node/src/runners/deno.js:26-31 (VALUE_FLAGS, REFUSED, DROPPED contain no `--shard`); `deno test --help` (2.9.6) lists "--shard <VALUE>"; docs/runners/deno.md "Discovery: Deno has no listing command; detjs applies Deno's rules". Not run.

evidence: `detjs tape` => "usage: detjs vitest|jest|node-test|mocha|bun-test|deno-test|tap|ava|jasmine|uvu ..." rc=2; node/bin/detjs.js:17-25 dispatch list.

missing: QUnit (CLI `qunit`) is not supported: `detjs qunit` prints the usage and exits 2.
evidence: `detjs qunit` => usage, rc=2; node/bin/detjs.js:17-25.

evidence: node/bin/detjs.js:12-25: runners accepted are vitest, jest, bun-test, deno-test, node-test, mocha, tap, ava, jasmine, uvu; anything else => usage rc=2.

evidence: node/bin/detjs.js:12-25 (wrapper commands only); node/package.json has no plugin export (main missing). Not run.

missing: Type-level test runners (`tsd`, `vitest typecheck` / `vitest --typecheck`, `expect-type` suites) have no support or message: no `detjs tsd`; `--typecheck` under `detjs vitest --det` was not verified.
evidence: node/bin/detjs.js:12-25 (no tsd); cache/runtime-id.js TREE_EXCLUDE mentions "Vitest typecheck: vitest/dist/tsconfig.tmp.*" only as a file to ignore. Not run.

missing: Playwright Test has no `detjs` shell: `detjs playwright test` prints the usage (rc 2); the only path is a measurement preload (`NODE_OPTIONS=--require node/src/register.js`) with controls but no per-test brackets or traces (J11). (Front-end agent covers the browser side.)
evidence: `detjs playwright test` => usage rc=2; docs/NODE.md J11 "Playwright Test is measured only (node/src/register.js ...): controls without per-test brackets or traces".

missing: Node 16 (legacy, still in old CI images): the addon loads (N-API 8) and Jest 27/29 run under `--det`, but nothing declares or tests it, and Vitest cannot be used there at all (Vitest 0.34, the only line for Node 16, is refused).

Not run (project mono-berry prepared, not executed).

missing: Lockfiles are keyed only in the directory detjs is started from: a per-package run (`cd packages/app && detjs jest ...`, the way npm/pnpm/yarn workspaces, Nx, Turbo and Lerna call test scripts) does not see the workspace's root `package-lock.json` / `pnpm-lock.yaml` / `yarn.lock`; only the content of ancestor `node_modules` directories covers a dependency change.
evidence: node/src/cache/runtime-id.js: `lists.lockfiles = LOCKFILES.map((f) => [f, native.fileDigest(path.join(root, f))])` with root = process.cwd(); packageRoots() adds `../node_modules` of every ancestor. Not run (mono-npm, mono-pnpm, mono-yarn1 prepared, not executed).
